row: With the help of our valued supporters, we’re working towards a better future for farm animals through compassion, education, and advocacy. We care for over 300 rescued animals at our flagship site, Goodheart Farm Animal Sanctuary based in Worcestershire. As part of our dedicated Education Programme, we facilitate meaningful connections between visitors and our residents, helping to reshape perceptions of “so-called” farm animals and raise awareness of their suffering. Alongside this, we back national campaigns to prevent animal cruelty and inspire people of all generations to make compassionate lifestyle changes.
